Software Engineer salary in the United States

Based on 1,007 current job listings that show pay on Fortune Jobs AI (updated November 26, 2026), listed pay for Software Engineer jobs in the United States is $126,000–$192,040 a year (middle 50% of listed salary midpoints). The median listed midpoint is about $154,108 a year. These figures describe listed pay in current postings, not a salary survey. Hourly and yearly figures are not mixed or extrapolated.

How to use this search

1,007 listings from 401 distinct advertised company names across 47 states are represented in this snapshot. Company names are counted as listed, not as a verified ownership group.

Explicit mentions in this page’s available listing text: testing (80), Python (54), AWS (27). These are text mentions, not a complete skill survey.

Compare the pay unit and sample size before comparing locations. These are advertised amounts from current postings; they do not measure accepted offers, total compensation or the whole labor market.

Frequently asked questions

What is typical listed pay?

The median listed salary midpoint is about $154,108 a year across 1,007 current postings. The middle 50% is $126,000–$192,040 a year.

Which employers list the highest pay?

Turing: about $520,000 a year (median of 32 listings); Sierra: about $310,000 a year (median of 2 listings); Generalist: about $290,000 a year (median of 2 listings); SYSTOLIC: about $274,000 a year (median of 17 listings); Braze: about $268,200 a year (median of 2 listings). Only employers with at least two usable listings of the same pay unit are compared.

What pay is listed for entry-level and new-grad jobs?

The median listed midpoint is about $92,950 a year from 36 entry-level and new-grad postings with usable pay. Internship listings are excluded from this comparison.

Is this a salary survey?

No. The figures are listed pay in current job postings on Fortune Jobs AI, not a salary survey or a prediction of an offer. Listings without usable pay are excluded.
